title: Hazelnut Biscuits
description: Italian 'brutti ma buoni' — ugly but good. Toasted hazelnuts blended into whisked egg whites and sugar for a chewy, nutty biscuit.
steps: Tip the hazelnuts on to a baking sheet and roast for 12–15 minutes until toasty brown. Allow to cool, then blitz in a food processor to breadcrumb consistency.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then slowly stir in the sugar a spoonful at a time, followed by the ground nuts. You should end up with a thick, crumbly paste.
Arrange heaped teaspoons of the mixture on two baking sheets lined with greaseproof paper, leaving around 3cm between.
Bake for 25 minutes or until just crisp, switching the trays halfway through. The biscuits should still be slightly soft inside.
notes: Makes around 20 biscuits. Per biscuit estimate.
